settings.python.label: Python command
settings.python.description: Interpreter used to run the PNG renderer. Use an absolute path if python3 is not on PATH.
settings.interval_minutes.label: Check interval (minutes)
settings.interval_minutes.description: How often the service checks whether the poem is due and whether the local date changed.
settings.notify.label: Notify on manual refresh
settings.notify.description: Show a notification when the poem is rotated from the bar button or the IPC command.
